doc.name: G — 30s mini action sequence set in a desert highway, suspenseful in tone, a mentor and a student, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: mini action sequence set in a desert highway, suspenseful in tone
Hero: a mentor and a student
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the mini action sequence set in a desert highway, suspenseful in tone form, built around a mentor and a student.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Keep the same time of day across all three acts unless the story's turn requires otherwise — and if it does, state the change explicitly.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a snap zoom in followed by a settle in Act 1 against a boom-down from a high wide to a tight insert in Act 3 — while holding the Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second mini action sequence set in a desert highway, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a boom-down from a high wide to a tight insert, shot on a 135mm telephoto at f/1.4, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second mini action sequence set in a desert highway, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves, shot on a 50mm normal at f/5.6, framed with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation; grade as a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second mini action sequence set in a desert highway, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a crane-up that starts at knee height and finishes above eye line, shot on a 50mm anamorphic with 2x squeeze at f/4, framed with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side; grade as a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
